patterns.note: Alternating dark green/charcoal and light grey/white background sections create clear visual segmentation, with content consistently centered within a defined maximum width.
Headings feature large, bold sans-serif typography, often highlighting a single key word in a bright accent color (lime green or yellow) for emphasis.
A sophisticated dark green and charcoal base is consistently contrasted with vibrant lime green and warm yellow accents for CTAs, highlighted text, and key visual elements.

A sticky navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking its logo, changing its background from transparent to solid white, and gaining a subtle shadow. Sections also reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport.
Hero sections prominently feature large, emotive imagery with overlaid text and clear calls to action, setting a strong visual tone for the page.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar uses a scroll-triggered state change. As the user scrolls past the initial hero section, the navigation bar transitions from a transparent, larger state to a compact, solid white background with a reduced logo size and a subtle drop shadow.

Content sections are introduced with scroll-triggered reveal animations. As each section enters the viewport, it subtly fades in and translates slightly upwards, creating a smooth and engaging flow down the page, likely implemented using CSS keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful headings (~3-4x body text) with a strong, bold weight, often highlighting a single word in an accent color. Body text is clear and well-spaced. Smaller uppercase labels are used for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and input fields (~4-8px). Cards have slightly more pronounced rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy. The hero section is quite airy. Content sections have generous vertical padding, creating a comfortable rhythm.

standout: The site effectively uses a vibrant, almost neon, lime green and a warm yellow as accent colors against a sophisticated dark green and charcoal palette, creating a distinctive and energetic brand identity. The large, bold typography with single-word color highlights in headings is a consistent and impactful visual signature.
